settings.student_source: E34's student (Adam 1e-5, 1000 steps, batch 32 of arm A, the alive (U, V) offsets of experiments/transport_test/results/large/alive.pt, Gamma and Delta frozen); arm A's weighting with the answer position as the trigger (half = L - 1)
settings.rows_source: the rows the base acts on, in thirds: cued items of its own task, uncued items of the three tasks, Pile train windows of 64 tokens; a departure from E34 (task windows alone or Pile alone), stated in the plan: the base differs from M behind the cue and must match M elsewhere
settings.pile_source: E34 C1 / faith_score.w0_check: 256 Pile val rows, 20-step adversary, seeds 0-2
settings.task_rows_source: the harness's PGD on the base's read rows, half cued and half uncued, KL at the answer position only (amendment 2026-11-22b): 256 rows give 256 answer terms; when M's spread over seeds 0-2 there is over f3_max, all 512 read-row prompts (256 cued, 256 uncued) on seeds 0-4 replace it, filed now so no choice is left to after the read
settings.scan_source: E268's filed scan settings (experiments/kstar_needed/results/predictions.json: 4 derangements x 64 examples, rows 1024, logit_rows 8192, cache_batch 32); seed the E-number
settings.eb_kinds_source: the scored kind (matched size) and its floor; the released M's row is descriptive, matched size only; matched-gain E_b is left out for cost (each item is a full K scan)

thresholds.F1_source: E34 C3's rule for the cued gap: held-out teacher gap <= 10% of the base's gap at M (cued read rows, arm A's weighting at the answer). gain_kept_min 0.8 is translated from E34's P >= 0.9 on a near-1 teacher into the log-odds unit, not measured (review 2026-11-22 Stage D finding 7); gain kept is over M cued, the amended lock's convention. On uncued read rows the student's answer log-odds within uncued_decades_max of the base's (the lock's bar), and its uncued teacher gap reported (amendment 2026-11-22b, finding 2)
thresholds.F2_source: faith_score.state_verdict: Pile harness PGD and stochastic ratios to the same-job W0, each against its own seed floor f (pass <= 1.5 / (1 + f)); only 'pass' counts as faithful
thresholds.F3_source: the 20-step adversary with the authors' KL at the answer position only (harness_pgd loss=, finding 1), on the base's task rows, ratio to M with the released decomposition on the same rows, pass <= 1.5 / (1 + f3), f3 = M's max/min - 1 over the adversary seeds there (ctl); a departure from E34 (Pile only), added because the base's skill lives at the answer of cued rows
thresholds.faithful_rule: F1, F2, F3 and F4 all 'pass'; otherwise that base's share and E_b rows stay empty and it reads 'no faithful featurization'; the score then follows two_base
thresholds.zero_rules: share: a zero update's numerator and gain exactly 0 on the base's decomposition; E_b: a zero update has no changed variable, every dd 0 and E_b 1 (E268 stage 0 (b))
thresholds.readings_source: scored by run.py's evidence rules (results/predictions.json thresholds.evidence: 7 of 9 triples, AUC >= 0.85, the Gaussian floor AUC < 0.85 on the third entry); E_b is a row, not the judge (cell done_when)
thresholds.f3_max_source: the Pile floor on the L40 is ~0.21 (E8, E11, E19; faith_score FLOOR_STOP 0.25); a task-row spread over 0.3 is 'far above' it (finding 6) and switches to the filed larger block; the rehearsal records f3
thresholds.F4_source: finding 2: mean |L00 - T0| in answer log-odds on the base task's cued and uncued read rows, at the student's target with its components, at most 1.5 x M's with the released decomposition on the same rows (ctl, measured); 1.5 is the harness's adversarial line used as a ratio, by analogy, not measured
thresholds.two_base_source: finding 3: with exactly two faithful bases, per task whose own base is faithful (2 tasks) and seed, the diagonal against the one faithful off-diagonal: 6 pairs, chance 1/2 each, all 6 above (P = 1/64 = 0.016 if independent; the seeds share base and rows, so effectively 2 pairs, P = 0.25); the AUC of the faithful bases' 6 diagonal against their 12 off-diagonal states >= 0.85, with the Gaussians' AUC on the floor field < 0.85; with fewer than two faithful bases nothing is scored ('not read'). Stated in the plan
thresholds.skip_source: E_b is read at matched size and the floor only (eb_kinds); its row at kind gain is not scored (finding 7)
thresholds.edge_rules: E_b_K is nan when K and the changed set do not meet (n_changed_K = 0): explained_share would read 1, the top reuse value, for an empty set (finding 5); a nan reading counts as not ranked (run.py's evidence edge rules)

expected.ctl: W0 passes w0_check (PGD KL within 10% of 0.69, CI-masked within 2% of 0.348, floor <= 0.25; E34's L40 floor ~0.21); task-row floors of the same order
expected.teach: lean: F2 passes on all three (E34's students passed the Pile harness on six teachers); F1 lean passes on cipher and addition, unsure on Yoruba (a language at 64-token windows); F3 unsure: never measured on a cue-gated skill
expected.share: lean: diagonal above both off-diagonals at matched size (an unlock re-gates the installed subcomponents); no lean on how far
expected.E_b: lean: E_b over K higher on the diagonal (the unlock's write change explained by gains on the base's own writes); no filed size
expected.zero: every zero-update number exactly as in zero_rules

timing_source: E119 (E34's students on the cluster L40): 1000 student steps 109-135 s with task windows, 154-167 s with Pile rows (experiments/teacher_route_split/results/*.json students.*.seconds); E_b's K scan unmeasured (E268's FLOP estimate ~8 min per item on an L40): the rehearsal measures cases per second
blind_to: a faithful student is faithful to the base on these rows and under a 20-step adversary only; the re-gating share is read with Gamma frozen at M's, so a base whose gates should differ reads through M's gates
